text: At a second-rate boys' boarding school in Saint-Cloud, the frail Christina and her husband's mistress Nicole are bound by their hatred of the tyrant Michel, who [humiliates his sickly wife|wrong|cruelty at home] and beats his lover. The two women sedate him with laced whiskey, drown him in a bathtub and sink the body in [the school's unused swimming pool|images|water and drowning]. When the pool is drained the corpse is gone, his suit returns from the cleaners, and [his figure appears in the school photograph|rules|reality comes apart] as Christina's weak heart begins to fail.
